name: Rizuhble's Sushi Chef Yamato
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Get after Lifestrike if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Stalker for it.
A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.
Hexes and slows stop you getting in.
Stuns keep catching you on the way in.
Their gun carry is out-shooting you.
Most of their damage is spirit.
Their team heals a lot. Spirit Burn does this job late, so sell it then.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Rebuilt from the FatherTran build Kieran plays: grapple phase is Melee Lifesteal, Extra Regen, Spirit Strike, Stalker, Improved Spirit, Spirit Snatch, Recharging Rush (pro: Stalker 96%, Melee Lifesteal 90%, Spirit Strike 52%, Recharging Rush 69%). Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge/Compress Cooldown/Echo Shard/Phantom Strike/Arcane Surge all gone. 4.8k spirit lands on Spirit Snatch at 8k.

Mystic Shot cut (FatherTran has it): it was only there to land a 4.8k gun spike that a Power Slash build never uses, and it would be a dead T2 sold later. Recharging Rush stays (Kieran's list) and sells for Refresher.

Health: Extra Regen → Healing Booster (Kieran's list, pro 67%), Spirit Lifesteal, Extra Health = 4.8k at 12.8k, Lifestrike (pro 85%) takes it to 7.2k at 21.6k so Melee Lifesteal isn't a dead 800. Extra Health → Colossus in the rich box (FatherTran and LYSTIC both run Colossus late).

1-build in order: Torment Pulse 16k, Mystic Burst → Tankbuster 19.2k (Power Slash full charge is 145 + 1.85x spirit, 295 + 2.35x at T3, so it clears 165 from mid game), Mystic Reverb on Power Slash 28k, Boundless 32.8k, Spirit Burn 39.2k (a T3 slash at ~150 spirit is ~650, over the 500 it needs), Infuser 44k instead of Spiritual Overflow because Overflow is a gun-slot item that would drop the health spike and needs you shooting heroes to charge.
Core 12 slots, 44k (was 54.4k). Ability order is FatherTran's (Power Slash maxed by point 7, grapple by 10). Lane box is Healing Rite since Extra Regen is now core.

Ability order: Grapple style: Flying Slash maxed first (T1 -18s, T2 +35 spirit, T3 2nd charge) like mobalytics (94-98% at 5-7) and Kieran's in-game In Your Face order (3221242333444111); Crimson T1/T2 (melee amp, 6% heal on hero hit) for the brawl phase, ult T1 at 10, then Power Slash maxed 11-13 for the late Tankbuster/Reverb/Spirit Burn transition (Spirit Burn needs T3 slash). Current FatherTran order maxed Power Slash by 7, which fights the grapple-early plan.

Item fit: Infuser → Colossus (Colossus moved up from the rich box; Spiritual Overflow takes its rich spot). Yamato's spirit damage comes in a few big hits (Power Slash 12s cd, Crimson Slash 16s cd), not many separate hits over 7s, and Infuser isn't in any public Yamato list checked (lockbuilds top 30 items, tracklock core/situational, FatherTran's build Kieran plays). Colossus fits an in-your-face grappler: 14m slow and -22% dash speed keeps them in slash range, +30% melee damage on the Lifestrike/Spirit Snatch heavies, 35% resists for 7s; tracklock Yamato late 25%, in tracklock defensives/actives and FatherTran's situational box. Built from the core Extra Health, so the Late slot stays a pure upgrade (+5.6k, total 44.8k); health now ends at 12.8k. Spirit Lifesteal note now points at Spiritual Overflow (FatherTran's upgrade of it).
Order: 3221242333444111 (data-first redo, see a7/order_yamato.json).

Threshold: checked on the new order, nothing moved. Recharging Rush at 9.6k (level 16, Flying Slash T3 charges in): bullets only, shotgun 5 x (5.31 + 15 x 0.154) x 1.1 = 42 per shot, 9 shots in 3.5s = 377 point blank (~225 at 60% pellets) vs 200, so it stays. Mystic Burst at 16.8k (100 spirit): Power Slash full charge 145+1.85×100 = 330, Crimson Slash T3 55+0.97×100 = 152 vs 80. Tankbuster at 19.2k (109 spirit): Power Slash full charge 347 vs 165 (Crimson Slash 161 doesn't, Power Slash does). Mystic Reverb at 28k (121 spirit, on Power Slash): 369 vs 100. Spirit Burn at 39.2k (171 spirit): Power Slash 461 + Crimson Slash 221 = 682 vs 500.

Round 9: Lifestrike moved from 21.6k to 12.8k, right after Healing Booster, and is now the 4.8k health spike (Melee Lifesteal → Lifestrike 3.2k + Healing Booster 1.6k). Melee Lifesteal sat as an 800 for 13 minutes before; tracklock.gg pro Yamato (last 30 days to Oct 19, 503 games) buys Lifestrike mid in 87% of games. Spirit Lifesteal and Extra Health move one spot later; same items, same total.

Round 9: Worth a try box: Rapid Recharge on Flying Slash (T3 gives the grapple an extra charge; Rapid Recharge adds 2 more, 30% faster charge cooldown and +14 spirit on charged abilities; same idea as Kieran's Rapid Recharge Haze).

Round 10: Restorative Shot added first in lane (800; heals 50 off a hero every 6s, +6% weapon damage). Tracklock pro Yamato (last 30 days to Oct 19, 503 games) buys it early in 97% of games, the joint most-bought item with Stalker, and Yamato's gun fires a spread up close after every grapple (RULES: good on spread guns). Sold for Spirit Burn, the 13th core item. Spirit 4.8k moves 8k → 8.8k, health 12.8k → 13.6k.
Round 10: rich-box notes for Spiritual Overflow and Healing Tempo now say what they upgrade and what they do (were 'Expensive late upgrade to Spirit Lifesteal.' and 'Upgrade.').

Round 11: Mystic Reverb moved before Tankbuster, so the tier 4s no longer run Reverb → Boundless → Spirit Burn → Colossus from 28.8k; Tankbuster sits between, and the late run starts after 30k. No pivot: her kit has one job, grapple in and kill one target.
Round 12: removed the Worth a try box (Rapid Recharge instead of Recharging Rush).
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: renamed Sushi Chef -> Spirit Slash (style wasn't in the name), desc 'Spirit Yamato'; order back to FatherTran's (the build Kieran plays and this build's item source) 3112411222344343, so Power Slash, which carries Mystic Reverb, Tankbuster and Spirit Burn, is maxed first instead of last; Healing Booster moved before Lifestrike (health 4.8k at 12k) and Recharging Rush after it (Flying Slash only has charges at T3, reached at 13.6k with this order); Healing Tempo moved from rich to Slot locked (Kieran's rule); Reactive Barrier note no longer claims hooks; Counterspell/Spirit Resilience notes fixed; duplicate sell notes removed.
Round 15: name back to Kieran's own choice 'Rizuhble's Sushi Chef Yamato'; Divine Barrier added to the rich box with 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel Magic is in Counters).
Round 17: Dispel Magic note 'Hexes and slows stop you getting in.' (Yamato has no grapple). Rich Spiritual Overflow note 'Upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal.'.
Round 20: late list Witchmail, Spiritual Overflow, Diviner's Kevlar, Refresher (luxury last); core+late 74.4k.
Round 23: kit re-read, no item change (see log).
Round 25: ability order 3112411222344343 -> 1132242332113444 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost pass: Boundless Spirit and Mystic Reverb swapped so Reverb is bought with more spirit power behind it.
